import json, hashlib, os
from pathlib import Path
bars_path = Path('trading_team/market_archive/2026-09-30/7f8be2f08470b776027d233d1c4280665d6866b2eb1a8823921fc7eb5b273795.json')
receipt_path = Path('trading_team/market_archive/receipts/e2439767125f6659bc801602b57c0080cdbbb39c19e7d4ab2309991543218cfe.json')
result_path = Path('docs/audits/2026-10-14-maker80-result-reconstructed.json')
recon_path = Path('docs/audits/2026-10-14-maker80-reconstruction.json')
old_path = Path('docs/audits/2026-10-01-isolated-data-quality-maker.json')

def load(p):
    b = p.read_bytes()
    return json.loads(b), hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

bars, bars_sha = load(bars_path)
receipt, receipt_sha = load(receipt_path)
result, result_sha = load(result_path)
recon, recon_sha = load(recon_path)
old, old_sha = load(old_path)

business_date = bars.get('date')
bar_codes = set(bars.get('bars', {}).keys())
receipt_codes = set(receipt.get('codes', []))
invalid_date = []
invalid_ohlc = []
suspended = []
for code, bar in bars.get('bars', {}).items():
    # print sample keys once for deterministic understanding
    is_suspended = bool(bar.get('suspended', False))
    if is_suspended:
        suspended.append(code)
    if bar.get('date') "'!= business_date:
        invalid_date.append(code)
    if not is_suspended:
        low, high = bar.get('"'low'), bar.get('high')
        open_, close = bar.get('open'), bar.get('close')
        ok = low is not None and high is not None and open_ is not None and close is not None and low <= open_ <= high and low <= close <= high and low <= high
        if not ok:
            invalid_ohlc.append({'code': code, 'bar': bar})

computed = {
    'business_date': business_date,
    'bar_count': len(bar_codes),
    'receipt_code_count': len(receipt_codes),
    'codes_match': sorted(bar_codes) == sorted(receipt_codes),
    'bar_codes': sorted(bar_codes),
    'receipt_codes': sorted(receipt_codes),
    'payload_hash_match': bars.get('payload_hash') == receipt.get('payload_hash'),
    'bars_payload_hash': bars.get('payload_hash'),
    'receipt_payload_hash': receipt.get('payload_hash'),
    'invalid_date_count': len(invalid_date),
    'invalid_date_codes': invalid_date,
    'invalid_ohlc_count': len(invalid_ohlc),
    'suspended_count': len(suspended),
    'suspended_codes': suspended,
    'result_fields_match_computed': {
        'business_date': result.get('business_date') == business_date,
        'bar_count': result.get('bar_count') == len(bar_codes),
        'receipt_code_count': result.get('receipt_code_count') == len(receipt_codes),
        'codes_match': result.get('codes_match') == (sorted(bar_codes) == sorted(receipt_codes)),
        'payload_hash_match': result.get('payload_hash_match') == (bars.get('payload_hash') == receipt.get('payload_hash')),
        'invalid_date_count': result.get('invalid_date_count') == len(invalid_date),
        'invalid_ohlc_count': result.get('invalid_ohlc_count') == len(invalid_ohlc),
        'suspended_count': result.get('suspended_count') == len(suspended),
        'source_file_sha256.bars': result.get('source_file_sha256', {}).get('bars') == bars_sha,
        'source_file_sha256.receipt': result.get('source_file_sha256', {}).get('receipt') == receipt_sha,
    },
    'result_sha': result_sha,
    'recon_sha': recon_sha,
    'recon_result_hash_binding': {
        'actual_equals_result_sha': recon.get('actual_result_sha256') == result_sha,
        'expected_equals_result_sha': recon.get('expected_result_sha256') == result_sha,
        'persistent_result_path': recon.get('persistent_result_path'),
        'original_directory_missing_label': recon.get('original_directory_missing'),
        'original_maker_task': recon.get('original_maker_task'),
        'original_maker_issue': recon.get('original_maker_issue'),
        'schema': recon.get('schema'),
        'method': recon.get('method'),
    },
    'historical_old_hashes': {
        'old_audit_sha': old_sha,
        'old_output_sha': old.get('output', {}).get('sha256'),
        'old_bars_sha': old.get('frozen_input', {}).get('bars_file_sha256'),
        'old_receipt_sha': old.get('frozen_input', {}).get('receipt_file_sha256'),
        'old_output_schema': old.get('output', {}).get('schema'),
        'old_output_matches_independent_check': old.get('output', {}).get('output_matches_independent_check'),
        'old_source_hashes_matched': old.get('output', {}).get('source_hashes_matched'),
        'old_task_id': old.get('remote', {}).get('task_id'),
        'old_task_status': old.get('remote', {}).get('task_status'),
        'old_agent_id': old.get('preflight', {}).get('agent_id'),
    },
    'sample_bar_keys': sorted(next(iter(bars.get('bars', {}).values())).keys()) if bars.get('bars') else [],
}
print(json.dumps(computed, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
